1.consolidated_definition: Cachear, buscar palpando en la vestimenta o en el cuerpo de una persona objetos prohibidos ocultos, como armas, drogas, etc. “Nacarile” sobre si se dejará “catear” en las SanSe.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To frisk, to search by feeling for prohibited objects hidden on a person's clothing or body, such as weapons, drugs, etc. To grope over whether one will be searched at the SanSe (San Juan Metro Station).
